title: Workflows
subtitle: Build and run agent workflows on a canvas.

no_work_items: No work items in this view.
create_hint: Start blank or from a built-in template. Bind its people and agents before publishing.

name: Workflow name
save_error: Could not save. Your edits are preserved.
